description:
About 2Nspira

2Nspira helps businesses improve how they work through technology, workflow improvement, and practical digital solutions.

We are building our client base and seeking a hands-on Business Development Lead to help turn our capabilities into clear offers, meaningful relationships, and paying engagements. You will work directly with the founder to shape our approach and establish our first client relationships.

The opportunity

Your mission will be to help 2Nspira win its first clients and build a repeatable approach to generating new business.

This role combines strategy with direct execution. You will identify promising markets, refine how we present our services, connect with decision-makers, and move opportunities from initial conversation through proposal and agreement.

This is an individual contributor role with ownership of business development activities. You should enjoy building from the beginning and personally researching prospects, conducting outreach, making introductions, and following through.

Location and schedule

This is a full-time, remote employee position for candidates based in the New York City metropolitan area, including nearby New Jersey and Connecticut.

The expected schedule is approximately 40 hours per week, primarily during Eastern Time business hours. Occasional in-person client meetings, networking events, and business development activities in NYC are part of the role.
responsibilities:
• Partner with the founder to define target customers, initial service offerings, and a clear explanation of 2Nspira’s value.
• Identify businesses with operational or technology needs that align with our capabilities.
• Generate opportunities through personalized outreach, networking, professional relationships, and referral partnerships.
• Build relationships with business owners and decision-makers throughout the NYC metropolitan area.
• Conduct initial discovery conversations and arrange qualified meetings with the founder.
• Help prepare proposals, communicate business value, and support negotiation and closing.
• Maintain an accurate prospect pipeline with documented conversations, clear next steps, and realistic opportunity assessments.
• Gather prospect feedback to improve our messaging and service offerings.
• Collaborate with our AI assistants on research, preparation, and follow-up while reviewing accuracy and maintaining personal attention.
• Track results and recommend improvements based on qualified conversations, proposals, and business generated.
qualifications:
• Demonstrated experience acquiring clients for consulting, technology, professional services, or a related business.
• Experience generating opportunities without relying on an established stream of inbound leads.
• Strong discovery, relationship-building, communication, and sales skills.
• The ability to explain technical services through practical business outcomes.
• Initiative and comfort working in an early-stage business where processes are still developing.
• Sound judgment about customer fit and commitments we can realistically deliver.
• An organized, consistent approach to outreach, follow-up, and pipeline management.
• Residence in the NYC metropolitan area and availability for occasional local meetings and events.

Established relationships with relevant business owners and decision-makers are a plus. We also value your ability to build new relationships, understand customer needs, and earn business through thoughtful, consistent outreach.
additionalDetails:
What success looks like

During your initial months, you will help establish:
• A focused target market and clear initial service offers.
• A researched pipeline of suitable businesses and decision-makers.
• Consistent, qualified discovery conversations.
• Proposals connected to genuine customer needs.
• Initial paying clients and a practical process for developing future business.

You and the founder will establish goals based on available resources and the sales cycle. Performance will reflect both business results and the quality of the pipeline you develop.

Compensation

• Annual base salary: $100,000.
• Target annual performance incentives: $30,000.
• Total annual on-target earnings: $130,000.

Performance incentives will be governed by a written plan defining targets, eligible business, and payment terms. Incentive earnings depend on performance and are not guaranteed.

Benefits

• Employer-supported medical coverage.
• 15 days of paid vacation annually.
• Paid company holidays.
• Sick leave and other protected leave applicable to your work location.
• Company-provided laptop and necessary software.
• Reimbursement for approved business travel and expenses.

Benefit eligibility and coverage details will be provided during the hiring process.

Why join 2Nspira?

You will work directly with the founder, influence how we bring our services to market, and see the impact of your contributions.

This is an opportunity for someone who values ownership, practical problem-solving, and building lasting business relationships.

How to apply

Click Apply on this page and submit:
• Your résumé or professional profile.
• A brief cover letter describing your interest and relevant experience.
• The role-specific application questionnaire.

We would like to learn how you have helped a services business acquire clients, your personal contribution to those results, and how you approach business development for an early-stage company.

Please avoid sharing confidential information belonging to previous clients or employers.
